mapper.select: SELECT t.OBJECTID, t.NAME, t.PREFIXION , t.SOURCEID, t.DESCRIBE,t.FOREIGNID,t.ZIPKEY,t.ZIPPATH,t.WORKSPACEID FROM ${TABLENAME} t where t.OBJECTID = #{OBJECTID}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${_parameter} ( "OBJECTID" SERIAL primary key, "NAME" varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, "PREFIXION" int NOT NULL, "SOURCEID" int DEFAULT -1, "DESCRIBE" varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (OBJECTID) )
mapper.select: select , a.NAME aNAME,a.TYPE aTYPE,a.AFFIXFILEID from PROJECT t left join AFFIXTABLE_${PREFIXION} a on a.OBJECTID=t.SOURCEID
SELECT max(t.PREFIXION) PREFIXION FROM PROJECT t
